sb.name: Aberrant Spirit
sb.ac: 11 + the level of the spell (natural armor)
sb.languages: Deep Speech, understands the languages you speak

traits.name: Hit Points
traits.desc: equal the aberration's Constitution modifier + your spellcasting ability modifier + ten times the spell's level

traits.name: Regeneration (Slaadi Only)
traits.desc: The aberration regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point.

traits.name: Whispering Aura (Star Spawn Only)
traits.desc: At the start of each of the aberration's turns, each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or take 3d6 psychic damage, provided that the aberration isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The aberration makes a number of attacks equal to half this spell's level (rounded down).

actions.name: Eye Ray (Beholderkin Only)
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +3 + summonSpellLevel to hit, range 30 ft., one creature. Hit: 1d8 + 3 + the spell's level psychic damage.

actions.name: Claws (Slaadi Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 + summonSpellLevel to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d10 + 3 + the spell's level slashing damage. If the target is a creature, it can't regain hit points until the start of the aberration's next turn.

actions.name: Psychic Slam (Star Spawn Only)
actions.desc: Melee Spell Attack: +3 + summonSpellLevel to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 1d6 + 3 + the spell's level psychic damage.

sb.name: Bestial Spirit
sb.ac: 11 + the level of the spell (natural armor)
sb.speed: 30 ft., climb 30 ft. (land only), fly 60 ft. (air only), swim 30 ft. (water only)

traits.name: Hit Points
traits.desc: equal the beast's Constitution modifier + your spellcasting ability modifier + ten times the spell's level

traits.name: Amphibious (Water Only)
traits.desc: The beast can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Flyby (Air Only)
traits.desc: The beast doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Pack Tactics (Land and Water Only)
traits.desc: The beast has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the beast's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The beast makes a number of attacks equal to half this spell's level (rounded down).

actions.name: Maul
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 + summonSpellLevel to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d8 + 4 + the spell's level piercing damage.

sb.name: Celestial Spirit
sb.ac: 11 + the level of the spell (natural armor)
sb.languages: Celestial, understands the languages you speak

traits.name: Hit Points
traits.desc: equal the celestial's Constitution modifier + your spellcasting ability modifier + ten times the spell's level

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The celestial makes a number of attacks equal to half this spell's level (rounded down).

actions.name: Radiant Bow (Avenger Only)
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +2 + summonSpellLevel to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 2d6 + 2 + the spell's level radiant damage.

actions.name: Radiant Mace (Defender Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 + summonSpellLevel to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d10 + 3 + the spell's level radiant damage, and the celestial can choose itself or another creature it can see within 10 feet of the target. The chosen creature gains temporary hit points equal to the damage dealt, provided it doesn't already have temporary hit points.

actions.name: Healing Touch (1/Day)
actions.desc: The celestial touches another creature. The target magically regains hit points equal to 2d8 + the spell's level.

sb.name: Elemental Spirit
sb.ac: 11 + the level of the spell (natural armor)
sb.speed: 40 ft., burrow 40 ft. (earth only), fly 40 ft. (air only hover), swim 40 ft. (water only)
sb.damage_resistances: lightning; thunder (air only); piercing; slashing (earth only); acid (water only)
sb.languages: Primordial, understands the languages you speak

traits.name: Hit Points
traits.desc: equal the elemental's Constitution modifier + your spellcasting ability modifier + ten times the spell's level

traits.name: Amorphous Form (Air, Fire, and Water Only)
traits.desc: The elemental can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The elemental makes a number of attacks equal to half this spell's level (rounded down).

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 + summonSpellLevel to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d10 + 4 + the spell's level bludgeoning damage (Air, Earth, and Water only) or fire damage (Fire only).

sb.name: Fey Spirit
sb.ac: 11 + the level of the spell (natural armor)
sb.languages: Sylvan, understands the languages you speak

traits.name: Hit Points
traits.desc: equal the fey's Constitution modifier + your spellcasting ability modifier + ten times the spell's level

traits.name: Fey Step
traits.desc: As a bonus action, the fey can magically teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

traits.name: Darkening Step (Deceitful Only)
traits.desc: Immediately after using its Fey Step, the fey can fill a 5-foot cube within 5 feet of it with magical darkness, which remains until the end of the fey's next turn.

traits.name: Ecstatic Step (Joyful Only)
traits.desc: Immediately after using its Fey Step, the fey can choose a creature it can see within 10 feet of it and force it to succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or be charmed by the fey for 1 minute. The charm ends if the fey or any of its companions deals any damage to the target.

traits.name: Impassioned Step (Furious Only)
traits.desc: Immediately after using its Fey Step, the fey has advantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The fey makes a number of attacks equal to half this spell's level (rounded down).

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 + summonSpellLevel to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d6 + 3 + the spell's level piercing damage + 1d6 force damage.

al: chaotic evil Demon only or lawful evil Devil only or neutral evil Yugoloth only

sb.name: Fiendish Spirit
sb.alignment: chaotic evil Demon only or lawful evil Devil only or neutral evil Yugoloth only
sb.ac: 11 + the level of the spell (natural armor)
sb.speed: 40 ft., climb 40 ft. (demon only), fly 60 ft. (devil only)

traits.name: Hit Points
traits.desc: equal the fiend's Constitution modifier + your spellcasting ability modifier + ten times the spell's level

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The fiend has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Death Throes (Demon Only)
traits.desc: When the fiend drops to 0 hit points or the spell ends, the fiend explodes, and each creature within 10 feet of it must make a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC. A creature takes 2d10 + the spell's level fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Devil's Sight (Devil Only)
traits.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the fiend's darkvision.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The fiend makes a number of attacks equal to half this spell's level (rounded down).

actions.name: Bite (Demon Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 + summonSpellLevel to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d12 + 3 + the spell's level necrotic damage.

actions.name: Claws (Yugoloth Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 + summonSpellLevel to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d8 + 3 + the spell's level slashing damage. Immediately after the attack hits or misses, the fiend can magically teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

actions.name: Hurl Flame (Devil Only)
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +3 + summonSpellLevel to hit, range 150 ft., one target. Hit: 2d6 + 3 + the spell's level fire damage. If the target is a flammable object that isn't being worn or carried, it also catches fire.

sb.name: Shadow Spirit
sb.ac: 11 + the level of the spell (natural armor)
sb.languages: Common, understands the languages you speak

traits.name: Hit Points
traits.desc: equal the shadow's Constitution modifier + your spellcasting ability modifier + ten times the spell's level

traits.name: Bloodthirsty Frenzy (Fury Only)
traits.desc: The spirit has advantage on attack rolls against frightened creatures.

traits.name: Shadow Stealth (Fear Only)
traits.desc: While in dim light or darkness, the spirit can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

traits.name: Weight of Ages (Despair Only)
traits.desc: Any beast or humanoid, other than you, that starts its turn within 5 feet of the spirit has its speed reduced by 20 feet until the start of that beast or humanoid's next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The spirit makes a number of attacks equal to half this spell's level (rounded down).

actions.name: Chilling Rend
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 + summonSpellLevel to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2d8 + 3 + the spell's level cold damage.

actions.name: Dreadful Scream (1/Day)
actions.desc: The spirit screams. Each creature within 30 feet of it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or be frightened of the spirit for 1 minute. The frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

sb.name: Undead Spirit
sb.ac: 11 + the level of the spell (natural armor)
sb.languages: Common, understands the languages you speak

traits.name: Hit Points
traits.desc: equal the undead's Constitution modifier + your spellcasting ability modifier + ten times the spell's level

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement (Ghostly Only)
traits.desc: The undead can become incorporeal while moving and pass through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. If it ends its turn inside an object, it is shunted to the nearest unoccupied space and takes 1d10 force damage for every 5 feet traveled.

traits.name: Festering Aura (Putrid Only)
traits.desc: Any creature, other than you, that starts its turn within 5 feet of the undead must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC or be poisoned until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The spirit makes a number of attacks equal to half this spell's level (rounded down).

actions.name: Deathly Touch (Ghostly Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 + summonSpellLevel to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 1d8 + 3 + the spell's level necrotic damage, and the creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or be frightened of the undead until the end of the target's next turn.

actions.name: Grave Bolt (Skeletal Only)
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +3 + summonSpellLevel to hit, range 150 ft., one target. Hit: 2d8 + 3 + the spell's level necrotic damage.

actions.name: Rotting Claw (Putrid Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 + summonSpellLevel to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d6 + 3 + the spell's level slashing damage. If the target is poisoned, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC or be paralyzed until the end of its next turn.
